# Incident Severity Levels

Incidents are classified from SEV1 (most severe) to SEV4.

## SEV1

A SEV1 is a full outage or data loss affecting more than 10 percent of customers. The incident commander must publish a status page update within 20 minutes of declaring a SEV1 and every 30 minutes after that.

## SEV2 and below

A SEV2 is a major degradation of a core feature. SEV3 and SEV4 cover minor bugs and cosmetic issues and do not page outside business hours.

## Postmortems

Every SEV1 and SEV2 requires a blameless postmortem, published within 5 business days of resolution.
